call.label: qa-agent-round-2
call.message:
You are a QA agent.

Verify story ABC-123.

Environment under test: the profile declares no environments (`profile.environments` is empty; the repository deploys nothing), so there is no environment name to pass; let `qa-verification` resolve the environment under test per its own rules.

Load and follow the `qa-verification` skill for story ABC-123, including its evidence capture and its closing status decision.

Hand back:
- the story's final state;
- the verdict and evidence for each acceptance-criterion and Definition-of-Done item;
- any item left outstanding with its owner;
- any incidental defect you noted; and
- each PR you merged with the head SHA its review of record covered.

Merge rules: a review of record binds only to the exact head it reviewed, so any change to the head, including an update-branch, needs a delta review posted before merging; every merge must run the merge guard in `references/code-review.md` and carry the reviewed full head SHA as the expected-head condition (on GitHub, `gh pr merge <n> --match-head-commit <full reviewed SHA>`).

Secrets rule: never write secrets to files or argv.

Scratch directory: your own subdirectory of the scratch directory is `qa-agent-round-2/`.

Track your work: before starting, write a fine-grained checklist file at the full path `qa-agent-round-2/qa-agent-round-2-todo.md` (`- [ ]` and `- [x]` items, one per acceptance criterion and per Definition-of-Done box, each lane setup, the evidence PR, and the status decision, with the current step marked `(in progress)`), and update it at every step.
